note_en: Verb/adjective + 得 + description shows degree or result: 锅要烧得极热 "the wok has to be heated until it's extremely hot"; 切得比头发还细 "cut finer than a hair." What follows 得 is what the action led to or how intense it was. English often uses an adverb ("very hot") or "so … that," but Chinese needs 得 here.
